data.name: Rushna
data.gender_notes: Rushna is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Ruhs’ meaning spirit and ‘An’ meaning light. The name Rushna therefore signifies a radiant spirit. It is also associated with the tranquility and beauty of the moon. The name Rushna carries the meaning “Moonlight, radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Rushna usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rushna is a spiritual name that embodies the tranquility and beauty of the moon. It is believed to bring a sense of inner peace and calmness, and is a reminder of the divine light that resides within each one of us.
data.etymology: Rushna belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moonlight, radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rushna total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: رشنا
in_arabic.long_meaning: رشنا هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'رَشَنَ' الذي يعني الإشراق والضوء الساطع. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى النور الباهر الذي يملأ المكان بالإضاءة. ويرتبط هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية بالضوء الروحي والمعنوي الذي يهدي الإنسان إلى الطريق الصحيح.

in_urdu.name: روشنا
